"""Disposable scope probe; not a delivery oracle or a behavioral experiment."""
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

ROOT = Path('/Users/neon/soodles')
OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
FIXTURE = ROOT / 'docs/experiments/exact-head-candidate-binding/observer.py'
identity = json.loads((OUT / 'source-identity.json').read_text())
for name, digest in identity['files'].items():
    assert hashlib.sha256((ROOT / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == digest, name
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('fixture_helpers', FIXTURE)
fixture = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(fixture)
records = []
for label, verdict in [('rejected', 'REJECT'), ('admitted', 'ADMIT_IMPROVEMENT')]:
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='comparison-byte-scope-') as directory:
        root = Path(directory).resolve()
        fixture.git(root, 'init', '-b', 'main')
        for source in ROOT.glob('*.py'):
            (root / source.name).write_bytes(source.read_bytes())
        for name in ('provider-execute', 'policy/runtime.lock.json'):
            fixture.write(root, name, (ROOT / name).read_bytes())
        baseline, treatment = b'baseline\n', b'treatment\n'
        fixture.write(root, fixture.SUBJECT, baseline)
        base = fixture.commit(root, 'Fixture baseline')
        fixture.write(root, fixture.SUBJECT, treatment)
        artifacts = [
            (fixture.TASK, 'task', b'Require the supplied comparison to admit this candidate.\n'),
            (fixture.OBSERVER, 'observer', b'Fixture only; never executed.\n'),
            (fixture.BASELINE_RAW, 'baseline', b'{"fixture":true}\n'),
            (fixture.TREATMENT_RAW, 'comparison', (json.dumps({'decision': verdict, 'fixture': True})+'\n').encode()),
            (fixture.NONCASE_RAW, 'noncase', b'{"fixture":true}\n'),
            (fixture.RESULTS, 'results', b'Synthetic comparison; no model run.\n'),
        ]
        for path, _, data in artifacts:
            fixture.write(root, path, data)
        manifest = fixture.evidence_manifest(1, baseline, treatment, artifacts)
        fixture.write(root, fixture.MANIFEST, (json.dumps(manifest)+'\n').encode())
        head = fixture.commit(root, 'Fixture comparison evidence')
        contract = fixture.contract(base, fixture.digest(artifacts[0][2]), fixture.digest(artifacts[1][2]))
        contract['acceptance'] = 'Behavior comparison must admit this exact candidate before delivery.'
        contract['trigger'] = 'Scope qualification of byte validation versus comparison decisions.'
        issue = {'url': 'https://api.github.com/repos/ed3c/soodles/issues/1',
                 'html_url': 'https://github.com/ed3c/soodles/issues/1', 'number': 1,
                 'body': fixture.issue_body(contract), 'state': 'open'}
        readback = OUT / (label + '-synthetic-issue.json')
        readback.write_text(json.dumps(issue, indent=2)+'\n')
        argv = [sys.executable, '-B', str(root / 'soodles.py'), 'candidate', 'verify', str(readback), base, head]
        # The CLI selects its installed source root, so the fixture includes exact source bytes.
        process = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
        record = {'case': label, 'declared_fixture_decision': verdict,
                  'argv': argv, 'cwd': str(root), 'exit': process.returncode,
                  'stdout': process.stdout, 'stderr': process.stderr}
        identity_process = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-B', str(root/'soodles.py'), 'landing', 'identity'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
        verifier = json.loads(identity_process.stdout)['verifier_sha256']
        tree = fixture.git(root, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD^{tree}')
        repo = {'full_name': 'ed3c/soodles'}
        claim = {'repository': 'ed3c/soodles', 'issue': 1, 'pr': 2, 'head': head,
                 'tree': tree, 'base_head': base, 'run_id': 10, 'run_attempt': 1,
                 'worktree': 'fixture', 'verifier_sha256': verifier}
        snapshot = {'issue': issue,
            'pr': {'number': 2, 'html_url': 'https://github.com/ed3c/soodles/pull/2',
                   'body': 'Refs ed3c/soodles#1', 'head': {'repo': repo, 'sha': head, 'ref': 'fixture'},
                   'base': {'repo': repo, 'sha': base, 'ref': 'main'}, 'state': 'open', 'draft': False, 'merged': False, 'mergeable': True},
            'run': {'id': 10, 'run_attempt': 1, 'repository': repo, 'head_repository': repo,
                    'head_sha': head, 'event': 'pull_request', 'path': '.github/workflows/runtime.yml',
                    'status': 'completed', 'conclusion': 'success'},
            'commit': {'sha': head, 'tree': {'sha': tree}},
            'branch': {'name': 'main', 'commit': {'sha': base}},
            'jobs': {'total_count': 1, 'jobs': [{'id': 11, 'name': 'runtime-evidence',
                     'run_id': 10, 'head_sha': head, 'status': 'completed', 'conclusion': 'success',
                     'steps': [{'name': name, 'status': 'completed', 'conclusion': 'success'} for name in
                               ['Canonical acceptance on the exact candidate head',
                                'Verify exact candidate evidence from fresh Issue readback']]}]}}
        claim_path, snapshot_path, checkpoint = [root/name for name in ('claim.json', 'snapshot.json', 'checkpoint.json')]
        claim_path.write_text(json.dumps(claim))
        snapshot_path.write_text(json.dumps(snapshot))
        record['synthetic_snapshot'] = snapshot
        record['landing_processes'] = []
        for operation in ('start', 'advance', 'dispatch'):
            arguments = [str(claim_path), str(snapshot_path), str(checkpoint)] if operation == 'start' else [str(checkpoint), str(snapshot_path)]
            command = [sys.executable, '-B', str(root/'soodles.py'), 'landing', operation, *arguments]
            observed = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
            record['landing_processes'].append({'argv': command, 'exit': observed.returncode,
                                               'stdout': observed.stdout, 'stderr': observed.stderr})
            if observed.returncode:
                break
        records.append(record)
result = {'scope': 'candidate.verify and cloud landing with synthetic successful CI input', 'source': identity,
          'synthetic_provider_input': True, 'provider_transport_count': 0,
          'records': records, 'authorizes_landing': False,
          'limitations': ['Canonical acceptance was not executed; successful CI is synthetic fixture input.',
                         'Landing request creation is observed; no provider transport executes.',
                         'A prose acceptance requirement is not a structured comparison requirement.',
                         'This cannot establish a live delivery bypass or an Agent decision barrier.']}
(OUT / 'qualification.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'evidence': str(OUT / 'qualification.json'),
                  'cases': [{'case': row['case'], 'candidate_exit': row['exit'],
                             'landing': [{'exit': p['exit'], 'owner': json.loads(p['stdout']).get('owner'),
                                          'action': json.loads(p['stdout']).get('action'),
                                          'request_created': 'request' in json.loads(p['stdout'])} for p in row['landing_processes']]} for row in records]}))
